title: Remitting a Payroll Period's Recovery against an Employee Meal Account
content:
Where an Employee Meal Account carries charges awaiting payroll recovery, Larkspur Table remits those charges to the employee's pay period by period, and this page sets out when a remittance falls due and how the desk books it.

## When a remittance falls due

A period's charges are remitted as soon as the charges awaiting recovery on the account stand above the restriction threshold printed against the plan, whatever remittance lag the plan would otherwise fix.

What is governed here is the value recovered from the employee's pay in one remittance. The desk works that value out for the account in front of it and books it; the account then shows a smaller outstanding figure and the employee sees a new line on their statement immediately.

## Booking it

The desk unlocks the agent tool `post_payroll_recovery_c9e76aa9` and calls it. The call books a recovery entry on the account's transaction ledger for the amount stated, marks it with the payroll period it is remitted for and the day it was remitted, and takes the charges awaiting payroll recovery down on the account by the same amount.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `meal_account_id` | The reference number of the Employee Meal Account the recovery is remitted against | An account reference, read from the meal account lookup before the call |
| `recovered_amount_usd` | The value recovered from the employee's pay in this remittance, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and rounded half to even at that precision; stored as a positive magnitude; an empty value is not accepted |
| `pay_period` | The payroll period this remittance is made for | Written as YYYY-MM-P followed by one digit for the half of the month, exactly as it is printed on the charges being recovered; an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the reference of the recovery entry booked, the value recovered in USD to two decimal places, the payroll period it was booked against and the charges awaiting payroll recovery still standing on the account after it. The presence of that entry reference is what indicates the remittance completed.

## Basis Q&A

**Whose action is this?** The desk's own. The tool is an agent tool, unlocked and called by the agent handling the account.

**What does the account look like afterwards?** The charges awaiting payroll recovery stand lower by the amount remitted, and the recovery entry is on the ledger with its payroll period and the day it was remitted.
